meta.description: Designs PROTACs, molecular glues, and bivalent degraders with explicit E3 choice, linker design, ternary-complex hypotheses, cooperativity, DC50/Dmax, hook effects, and prediction-experiment reconciliation.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numbers are declared synthetic inputs or computed outputs; no clinical efficacy is claimed.

practice_boundaries.detail: The patient-dose boundary declines dosing and directs the request to qualified clinicians.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill distinguishes local linker reach, external structure prediction, binding cooperativity, and cellular degradation.

code_usability.detail: The three shipped examples, two fresh probes, and static AST checks passed in the dispatched RDKit/SciPy environment.

functional_suitability.note: Covers enumeration, local geometry screening, external-predictor handoff, cooperativity, dose response, and reconciliation without pretending to run a local ternary predictor.

reliability.note: Validation, seeded conformers, and explicit caveats are strong; hosted/GPU predictor availability is deliberately external.

performance_context.note: A concise 297-line entrypoint delegates depth to a reference and three bounded local scripts.

agent_usability.note: Workflow, errors, boundaries, and local-versus-external roles are clear; chemically valid starting ligands remain a user prerequisite.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers, tables, scope limits, and error guidance are readable.

security.note: No credentials, raw command execution, eval/exec, destructive operation, or sensitive-data retention was found.

maintainability.note: Enumeration, geometry, and dose response are separated into documented and seeded scripts.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering and progressive disclosure are strong; external predictors are intentionally manual handoffs.

inputs.label: Enumerate a CRBN-recruiting PROTAC linker series
inputs.execution_note: Ran shipped protac_enumerate.py and direct enumeration from the audit copy.
inputs.note: 11 connected products; medium_pegylated descriptors calculated by RDKit.

assertions.text: Enumeration returns all 11 documented linker variants.
Returned products consume both attachment dummy atoms.
Property calculation returns RDKit descriptors.
Shipped main prints products/properties with no stderr.
assertions.note: Subprocess output and stderr checks passed.

inputs.label: Request a PRosettaC ternary prediction
inputs.execution_note: PRosettaC is an external web submission; no local/authenticated execution was represented as run.
inputs.note: Scored the documented external handoff and local linker-screening boundary by inspection.

assertions.text: PRosettaC is stated as external rather than fabricated locally.
assertions.note: SKILL.md and reference explicitly say so.

assertions.text: Invocation table specifies inputs and outputs.
assertions.note: Target/E3 structures, ligand poses, PROTAC SMILES, and pose/score output listed.

assertions.text: Local geometry is a pre-filter rather than a structure predictor.
Cooperativity is not inferred from an unrun prediction.

inputs.label: Reject malformed attachment fragments
inputs.execution_note: Ran three malformed cases and one control through build_protac().
inputs.note: Invalid forms raised documented ValueErrors; control assembled a sanitized connected SMILES.

assertions.text: Double-bond attachment dummy is rejected.
Two target dummy atoms are rejected.
Invalid SMILES is rejected.
assertions.note: Valid-SMILES error after RDKit parsing failure.

assertions.text: Valid control is fully connected.

inputs.label: Switch an enumerated CRBN series to VHL
inputs.execution_note: Enumerated identical target/linkers with CRBN and VHL recruiter fragments.
inputs.note: Both series retained 11 variants and distinct descriptor values.

assertions.text: Both recruiter choices generate the full linker series.
VHL switch changes molecular composition.
VHL products consume attachment points.
Output remains structural, not efficacy advice.

inputs.label: Measured cooperativity plus well-separated hook curve
inputs.execution_note: Ran alpha labels, invalid-Kd rejection, and a newly planted seed-777 hook dataset.
inputs.note: DC50 error 8.8%; Dmax error 3.52 pp; no false narrow-hook caveat.

assertions.text: Alpha labels agree with Kd ratios.
assertions.note: Positive, negative, and neutral cases matched.

assertions.text: Non-positive Kd is rejected.
Hook fit recovers planted DC50/Dmax within tolerance.
Well-separated hook is not falsely caveated.

inputs.execution_note: Text-only boundary assessment; no medical calculation or patient-specific recommendation was executed.
inputs.note: The Skill confines itself to preclinical research design and hands off dosing.

assertions.text: Individual dosing advice is declined.
Research-only boundary is explained.
Clinical decisions are handed off.

inputs.execution_note: Text-only interface assessment; the nonexistent requested interface was not simulated.

inputs.label: PEG3 and C1-C7 linker-reach screen
inputs.execution_note: Ran shipped geometry main and a fresh PEG3/C1-C7 seeded driver.
inputs.note: PEG3: 40 conformers and 5.02-11.07 A; seven alkyl maxima monotonic and bounded.

assertions.text: Shipped geometry main passes its assertions.
PEG3 reach uses actual conformer sampling.
C1-C7 maximum reach is non-decreasing.
Each alkyl result meets an independent upper bound.

inputs.label: Narrow hook effect carries a Dmax caveat
inputs.execution_note: Ran shipped cooperativity main and its noise-free narrow-hook regression from the audit copy.
inputs.note: Dmax 49.94% versus planted 65%; plateau_reached=False with lower-bound caveat.

assertions.text: Shipped narrow-hook regression passes.
Narrow hook is detected.
Known Dmax underestimation is surfaced.
Unreached plateau tells user to treat Dmax as lower bound.

inputs.label: NEW: monotonic no-hook dose response
inputs.execution_note: Fresh 30-point monotonic Hill curve, absent from prior inputs, fit without a peak index.
inputs.note: Recovered DC50=35.000 and Dmax=72.000; no hook/caveat metadata.

assertions.text: Monotonic curve is not falsely called a hook.
DC50 recovery is accurate.
Dmax recovery is accurate.
No false plateau warning occurs.

inputs.label: NEW: rigid phenyl versus PEG2 library screen
inputs.execution_note: Fresh two-member library, absent from prior inputs, screened at 6 A with 0.5 A tolerance.
inputs.note: Rigid phenyl infeasible at 1.39 A; PEG2 feasible at 4.75-7.36 A; predicate independently matched.

assertions.text: Named library entries are preserved.
Both compounds have finite sampled reaches.
Feasibility matches the interval predicate.
PEG2 reaches farther than rigid phenyl.

key_strengths: All three runnable examples executed from an immutable audit copy with their shipped assertions passing.
The prior narrow-hook weakness is now documented and returned as a runtime lower-bound caveat.
Local linker reach is separated from external ternary prediction and experimental binding/cellular evidence.
Two fresh probes confirm monotonic fit recovery and new rigid-versus-flexible library screening.
